quote: Talent gets you noticed. Discipline keeps you standing when nobody's watching.
caption: Applause fades. Habits stay on payroll.

quote: They counted me out before the game even started
caption: Let them do the math. You keep making moves.

quote: The odds were never against me, they were just the price of admission
caption: Morning reminder: the struggle was the ticket in.

quote: Real loyalty shows up after the storm, not just when skies are clear
caption: Anybody can stand with you in the sun. Respect the ones who stayed through the rain.

quote: Small circle, heavy roots. I'd rather have four solid than forty hollow.
caption: Count your people by weight, not by number.
